description: 连接东方财富妙想 MCP，基于 Choice 数据查询 A 股、基金、债券、指数、宏观、资讯公告和证券筛选等金融研究数据。

steps: Eastmoney supports OAuth 2.0 with PKCE S256 for this local runtime.
The runtime opens the Eastmoney authorization page and stores the returned credential locally.
After signing in, the grant can call the Eastmoney Choice-data MCP endpoint.

actions.name: call_tool
actions.description: Call a current Eastmoney MCP tool with JSON arguments. Discover the live schema first, then call the matching tool.

toolName.description: The exact tool name returned by Eastmoney MCP discovery.

arguments.description: JSON arguments matching the current inputSchema for the selected Eastmoney MCP tool.

inputSchema.description: Input for invoking one current Eastmoney MCP tool.

result.description: The current Eastmoney MCP result after standard MCP content normalization.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the Eastmoney MCP tool.

actions.name: list_tools
actions.description: List the current tool catalog and live input schemas exposed by Eastmoney Choice-data MCP.

inputSchema.description: Input for discovering Eastmoney MCP tools.

name.description: The exact Eastmoney MCP tool name to pass to call_tool.

description.description: The current tool description supplied by Eastmoney.

title.description: A human-readable title for the tool.

readOnlyHint.description: Whether Eastmoney expects the tool not to modify data.

destructiveHint.description: Whether Eastmoney indicates that the tool may be destructive.

idempotentHint.description: Whether repeated calls with the same arguments are idempotent.

openWorldHint.description: Whether the tool may interact with external entities.

annotations.description: MCP behavior hints supplied by Eastmoney for a tool.

inputSchema.description: The current JSON Schema for the tool arguments, supplied by Eastmoney MCP.

items.description: A tool currently exposed by Eastmoney MCP.

tools.description: Tools currently exposed by Eastmoney MCP.

outputSchema.description: The current Eastmoney MCP tool catalog.
